name: ANTONY QUENTIN ROY
title: ==QUALITY ASSURANCE MANAGER==  ·  ==QUALITY STANDARDS & TEAM EXCELLENCE==

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Quality Assurance Manager== with **20 years** in quality engineering and proven expertise in ==designing, implementing, and continuously improving quality standards== across organizations. Currently Sr. QA Manager at Concord Technologies, with a strong track record of ==developing quality policies and governance frameworks==, ==analyzing data to identify improvement opportunities==, ==coaching and mentoring diverse teams==, and ==ensuring adherence to quality standards==. Skilled at ==creating and presenting progress reports==, ==formulating strategies to enhance productivity and quality==, and ==helping employees achieve excellence==. Technical proficiency with data analysis tools, reporting systems, and quality metrics platforms. Excellent communicator with a demonstrated ability to ==work across departments== to solve quality problems and ==develop solutions aligned with company goals==. Strong eye for details and commitment to continuous organizational improvement.
sections.note: OPERATIONAL QA FOCUS — This summary emphasizes standards design, employee coaching, data analysis, and organizational quality culture (less technical automation). Verify: Do you have specific recruiting experience or would this be a new responsibility?

note: TRADITIONAL QA MANAGER FOCUS — This spec emphasizes quality standards design, employee coaching, data analysis, and reporting (more HR/operations than technical). 70–75% fit. IMPORTANT CONTEXT: This role is a different career path from your Sr. QA Manager position. It's more operational/HR-focused (recruiting, team coaching, policy) vs. technical quality engineering leadership. GAPS TO ADDRESS: (1) Recruiting experience—not in current resume; mention if you've supported hiring. (2) Data analysis depth—emphasize any statistical analysis, trend identification, or metrics work. (3) Employee development—highlight specific coaching/mentoring outcomes. STRENGTHS: Quality standards expertise, team mentoring, cross-functional collaboration, governance, continuous improvement.
